descriptionMarkdown:
### Fulgora Mall 
**Version 1.8 requires Factorio 2.1.** The last version compatible with Factorio 2.0 is [available here](https://github.com/niradar/factorio_blueprints/blob/main/blueprints/fulgora-mall/1.7.5.txt).

**New! Mark 2 version is now available in beta**. You can [check it out here](https://factorioprints.com/view/-OyOfubmzJlpBM8pIykD).


**Tech Level:**
- 4 planets tech
- Normal quality items only

**Input:**
- 2 Stacked turbo belts of scraps
- Heavy Oil

**Output:**
- All fulgora items (Except mech armor)
- Items needed on Fulgora (rails, belts, inserters, etc)
- 495 SPM

**To Start:**
- Just build the blueprint and connect all inputs, it will power itself
- If you want to make things faster, you can connect it to a power network

### Updates

##### v1.8 - 13/08/2026

* **Compatibility:** Updated circuit logic to work with Factorio 2.1

##### v1.7.5 - 26/07/2026

* **Fix:** Fixed a potential deadlock in the concrete voiding system


##### v1.7.4 - 26/07/2026

* **Fix:** Corrected the filter in the nuclear reactor buffer chest
* **Fix:** Added missing filters to several inserters
* **Fix:** Corrected the filter in the Tesla gun buffer chest
* **Cleanup:** Removed unused inserters, belts, and other leftovers
* **Production:** Added a production limit for Express underground belts
* **Input:** Reduced the heavy oil connections from two to one
* **Power:** Increased steam power output
* **Disposal:** Rebuilt the concrete recycling system to use the Factorio 2.1 concrete voiding method
* **Production:** Improved steel production when steel stock is low


##### v1.7.3 - 08/07/2026

* **Fix:** Replaced one Express splitter with a turbo splitter, removing the need for an Express splitter rocket
* **Balance:** Removed unnecessary beacons from the rocket silos to reduce power consumption
* **Fix:** Removed duplicate combinator production


##### v1.7.2 - 30/06/2026

* **Fix:** Added a missing power pole


##### v1.7.1 - 30/06/2026

* **Capacity:** Increased science storage
* **Logistics:** Moved science storage much closer to the rocket silos
* **Logistics:** Added an iron stick buffer chest
* **Logistics:** Separated the roboports for adding construction bots and logistics bots instead of using one for both
* **Logistics:** Added more requester chests to improve item flow. Belts are still the main transport method; requesters are mainly backup and support for end-game upgrades
* **Fix:** Stone buffer chests were not set to request stone
* **Disposal:** Improved stone disposal


##### v1.7 - 30/06/2026

* **Fix:** Removed leftover stack inserter production from the removed holmium setup
* **Fix:** Corrected the concrete condition for rocket silo production. It was set to `= 0` instead of below the target amount
* **Fix:** Moved accumulator quality production outside speed beacon coverage
* **Fix:** Moved lightning collector production outside speed beacon coverage as well
* **Fix:** All accumulators are now rare. Two accumulator were normal-quality accumulators
* **Balance:** Removed Quality Modules from assembling machine 3, chemical plant, bulk inserter, fast inserter, long-handed inserter, Tesla ammo, lightning rod, chests, and pump production
* **Logistics:** Moved recycler and beacon production earlier in the sushi flow
* **Logistics:** Added more requester chests to control item flow. The factory still works with belts, but bots will help more when upgrading it later
* **Disposal:** Added iron ore disposal
* **Disposal:** Added scraps requester
* **Disposal:** Improved concrete disposal. It still uses a 2.0 solution, not a 2.1 one
* **Production:** Added additional battery production to make late-game upgrades easier
* **Production:** Added Personal Battery MK3 production

##### v1.6 - 9/1/2026

* **Capacity:** Increased mall stock targets so you’re more likely to have enough when you need it
* **Fix:** Fast inserter production was using Quality Modules 2 instead of Quality Modules 3
* **Fix:** Corrected wrong request on the Level 2 roboport buffer chest
* **Fix:** Corrected wrong request on the Tesla turret buffer chest
* **Fix:** Fixed radar production
* **Fix:** Fixed battery delivery to personal roboport production
* **Throughput:** Added a 4th rocket silo
* **Logistics:** Converted several passive provider chests to buffer chests (better local availability / export control)
* **Export:** Now buffering all Fulgora intermediates in buffer chests for export
* **Balance:** Removed 2 holmium foundries (excess capacity)
* **Balance:** Removed quality modules from Quality Module 2 EMP production (not useful in this setup)
* **Balance:** Removed quality modules from bot production (not worth the complications in early–mid game)

##### v1.5.3 - 18/11/2025
- Fixed a wrong alert message

##### v1.5.2 - 16/11/2025

- Fix: Several chemical plants weren't connected correctly
- Fix: Incorrect inserters for constructor bots and logistics bots
- Fix: Replaced fast inserters to bulk inserters for assembling machine production to meet the correct rates
- Fix: Removed productivity modules from Lubricant production and replaced it with efficiency modules. No need for productivity when heavy oil is free
- Feat: Replaced some pipes with underground pipes for easier navigation in the factory
- Fix: Increased water production - the factory throwed ice while it needed it
- Feat: Added some efficiency modules to recyclers to reduce power requirements
- Feat: Increased lighting rods production by adding a stone bricks production as needed
- Feat: Added repair pack production
- Fix: 2 rocket fuel assembling machines weren't properly connected
